name: Inverse Rendering with Exponential Phase Function
aliases: Inverse Rendering with Proposed Phase Function
Physics-based Differential Renderer for Slab Estimation
definition: Estimation of scattering parameters (extinction coefficient σ_t, scattering coefficient σ_s, and phase function parameters Φ_p) from captured images of a homogeneous translucent slab with known geometry and known beam light source directions, using a physics-based differentiable renderer.
summary: Inverse Rendering with Exponential Phase Function estimates scattering parameters for homogeneous translucent slabs using a three-degree exponential phase function and analytical optimization, differing from neural methods by relying on explicit physical priors.
